title: Apparition (1)
author: Guy de Maupassant
note: Paris, at the end of an evening party: an old marquis of eighty-two tells the guests about the one adventure that has frightened him all his life, near Rouen in 1827. The story uses the passé simple: when you hear "je fis" or "il dit", think "I did", "he said".

segments.fr: On parlait de séquestration à propos d'un procès récent.
segments.en: People were talking about illegal confinement, in connection with a recent trial.
